items.briefing:
A threat actor known as Nightmare-Eclipse has released a new Windows exploit called "ShieldCrash," which could affect organisations running Windows systems — keep an eye out for guidance from your IT team on any urgent patches. Separately, attackers are using voice calls to trick employees into granting access to Microsoft 365 accounts through personal devices, highlighting risks when staff use their own phones or laptops for work. Australian CISOs are also flagging a resourcing gap in managing AI-related security risks, a concern relevant to any organisation adopting AI tools.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected phone call asking you to approve a login or provide work account details, hang up and verify the request through official channels before taking any action.

featured.title: OpenSSL funds six Australian students for Prague conference
featured.summary: Six university students will gain rare access to global cryptography work as travel, hotel and registration costs are covered for Prague.
